source: research/scenarios/kinematics_scara_probe.py against RoboDK 6.0.7.26935 (port 20523); the run stopped after the first robot because the RoboDK licence had expired ("API calls are limited")
method: target = SolveFK(q) * Rot(axis, t), axis = (cos a, sin a, 0) in the flange frame; SolveIK(target, q) succeeds for t <= max_ok (bisection on [0, 40] deg, 8 steps, resolution 0.156 deg; 40 = accepted at 40 deg)
reading: Only leans that tip the X axis of the J4-frame target against the J4 axis direction are limited: SolveIK fails once that component exceeds 0.2 (axis 90: sin 11.41 = 0.198 ok, sin 11.56 = 0.200 rejected; axes 45/135: sin(16.41)/sqrt(2) = 0.1997 ok, sin(16.57)/sqrt(2) = 0.2016 rejected; every other direction accepted up to 40). Probe 1 (robodk-probe-1.json) agrees: tilt rx0.2ry0.3 gives that component 0.2896 on IRB 910SC, Yamaha YK700 and the Brooks arms (rejected) and -0.2896 on Mitsubishi RH-3CH and Epson LS3, whose flange is Rx(180) from the J4 frame (accepted).
